messages:
jordan: Heads upIm seeing p50 stable but p95 jumps on the latency pane for /v1/embeddings whenever the quota-fallback kicks in. plot: https://internal.redwood/plots/embeds_tail.png

devika: Which percentile estimator does the dashboard use now? approx_percentile on rollups?

jordan: Right now it's our legacy approx_percentile which aggregates summaries then estimates. Works fine for large n but not when a small fallback bucket has outsized tail.

cedric: That explains it. small subgroup with n~8 but huge latency drags merged p95. We should surface subgroup sample counts in the UI.

jordan: Quick numbers: overall p95=420ms (n=250), primary p95=400ms (n=240), fallback p95=2200ms (n=8). The fallback is tiny but influential.

devika: Proposal: two changes. (1) Add per-line "# samples" pill and a conf label when n < 30. (2) Backend: switch rollups to t-digest sketches for percentiles and expose merge-error bounds.

cedric: t-digest is a good long-term fix. It merges nicely and gives tighter error curves. We need deterministic bucket keys when we rollup across shards though.

jordan: Also thinking about the UX: when p95 is driven by a subgroup with n < 10, we should show a small caret icon and tooltip: "low subgroup sample: percentile may be unstable" and optionally auto-suggest to "split by route_variant".

devika: API change: add ?include=percentile_sample_counts to the telemetry endpoint. Response will include list of {tag:value, count} but keep it shallow (flat arrays only).

cedric: For the rollups: store t-digest as base64 blob + sample_count. Expose estimated error as a percent string. The console can gray-out percentiles when error > 15%.

jordan: Implementation plan: UI PR (front-end) to add sample pill + tooltip + split toggle. Backend PR to return sample counts and t-digest meta. Also add an annotation layer for deploy-bot events so we can see when fallback/quota changes coincide.

deploy-bot: deploy/event: quota-fallback-trigger service=embeddings rule=rate_limit at=2025-03-12T16:05:10Z user=ops-bot

devika: Filing ticket: ENGPLAT-1437 for API + telemetry changes and ENGPLAT-1438 for console UX. I'll owner the API. Jordan can own the UI mocks.

cedric: One more cautionwe need to validate t-digest merge accuracy in our staging rollups (generate synthetic shards with skewed tails) before switching. I'll add a test harness.

jordan: Sounds good. I'll push a quick patch to show sample counts first; that should immediately reduce confusion in oncall.

devika: Thanks. Goal: avoid surprise alerts from merged-percentile flips during rollouts/quotas.

cedric: And document this in rollout runbook: "expect p95 fluctuations when subgroup sample_count < 30, use split view or wait 15m for counts to stabilise".

jordan: Will follow up with PR links + staging results in a few hours. :sparkles:
